description: KULIC Advisory, AICTIONBOT™ Workbench. Drafts a complete request for quotation in German or English following the Execution Toolkit template T10 (RFQ): title, RFQ number, issue and due date, buyer and contact, 1 scope and requirements, 2 commercial response table with the user's lines (description, specification, quantity, unit, delivery), 3 submission checklist and timeline with a question deadline, 4 weighted evaluation criteria (the user's own or a suggestion: price and total cost 40, quality 25, delivery 15, service 10, terms and risk 10), 5 clarifications in writing, 6 compliance and terms with payment terms, offer validity and governing law. Missing details are left as clearly marked placeholders in square brackets, never invented. Returns the full text ready to paste into an email or document, plus the link to the Excel template T10 that fill_template can fill. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Working template, not legal advice. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

criteria.description: Evaluation criteria with weights (any scale, normalised to 100).

due_date.description: Submission deadline, YYYY-MM-DD. Default issue date plus 14 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

lines.description: Lines: description, specs, qty, unit, delivery.

scope.description: Goods or services, objective and expected outcome.

title.description: What the request is about, e.g. 'Cleaning of the office building from 2027'.

name: create_rfq
title: Draft a request for quotation (RFQ) from the KULIC Advisory RFQ template: scope, requirements, response table, checklist, timeline, criteria, terms
